description: Indicateurs RSE de SNCF Réseau depuis 2016 is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données n'est plus mis à jour depuis 2020. Ce jeu de données contient l’ensemble des indicateurs de responsabilité sociétale de l’Entreprise (RSE) SNCF RESEAU depuis 2016. Ce jeu de données présente les indicateurs de la politique de responsabilité Sociétale de l’Entreprise (RSE) de SNCF RESEAU. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Indicateurs , RSE. The portal shows 2022-03-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
